title: a16z Podcast: Space -- the Near Frontier

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: When most people think of space, they think of outer space: Mars, billionaires with rockets, and the “final frontier”.
reader_summary.overview: When most people think of space, they think of outer space: Mars, billionaires with rockets, and the “final frontier”. But space innovation is actually playing out right now -- in an immediate and more accessible way, thanks to techonologies getting smaller, faster. The views expressed here are those of the individual AH Capital Management, L.L.C.
